heritage-banarasi-katan-silk-wedding-sar.title: Heritage Banarasi Katan Silk Wedding Saree with Pure Zari Border

supima-cotton-heavyweight-crew-neck-tshi.title: Supima Cotton Heavyweight Crew Neck Oversized T-Shirt

royal-oxford-pure-cotton-slim-fit-casual.title: Royal Oxford Pure Cotton Slim Fit Casual Shirt

stardust-celestial-925-sterling-silver-c.title: Stardust Celestial 925 Sterling Silver Crescent Moon & Star Charm Bracelet
stardust-celestial-925-sterling-silver-c.shortDescription: Solid 925 Sterling Silver Celestial Moon & Star Charm Bracelet

croissant-dome-minimalist-chunky-gold-st.title: Croissant & Dome Minimalist Chunky Gold Stacking Rings (Set of 3)

A cohesive trio consisting of a ribbed Parisian croissant band, a high-shine chunky dome ring, and a sleek comfort-fit band. Made from heavyweight 18K gold vermeil over 925 sterling silver that won't tarnish or turn green in water.

aura-nazar-18k-gold-paperclip-chain-evil.title: Aura Nazar 18K Gold Paperclip Chain & Mother-of-Pearl Evil Eye Pendant
aura-nazar-18k-gold-paperclip-chain-evil.shortDescription: 18K Gold Paperclip Chain with Mother-of-Pearl Evil Eye Charm

Designed to ward off negative energy while elevating everyday outfits.

y2k-dainty-18k-gold-butterfly-pave-huggi.title: Y2K Dainty 18K Gold Plated Butterfly Pavé Huggie Hoops
y2k-dainty-18k-gold-butterfly-pave-huggi.shortDescription: Dainty 18K Gold Plated Butterfly Huggie Hoops with Pavé Crystals

afsana-925-oxidized-silver-mirror-work-b.title: Afsana 925 Oxidized Sterling Silver Mirror-Work Boho Jhumkas

Lightweight, hypoallergenic, and ideal for college, kurti styling, and bohemian aesthetic fits.

vajra-22k-solid-yellow-gold-singapore-cu.title: Vajra 22K Solid Yellow Gold Singapore Curb Chain

devi-laxmi-22k-temple-gold-coin-pendant-.title: Devi Laxmi 22K Temple Gold Coin Pendant with Floral Filigree

Surrounded by an ornate handcrafted floral filigree circular frame and ruby accents. Represents wealth, prosperity, and divine blessings.

padmavati-royal-22k-heritage-kundan-polk.title: Padmavati Royal 22K Heritage Kundan & Polki Bridal Set

swarna-mahal-22k-heritage-gold-peacock-j.title: Swarna Mahal 22K Heritage Gold Peacock Jhumkas with Seed Pearls

aura-18k-rose-gold-solitaire-diamond-eng.title: Aura 18K Rose Gold Solitaire Diamond Engagement Ring

Stamped with 18K / AU750 hallmark.

kalyani-22k-royal-gold-handcrafted-filig.title: Kalyani 22K Royal Gold Handcrafted Filigree Bangles (Pair)

mira-22k-gold-pear-ruby-diamond-pendant-.title: Mira 22K Yellow Gold Pear Ruby & Diamond Pendant Necklace
